featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The SW-220-TX-W is the perfect solution for todays huddle spaces and small meeting rooms. This switcher is equipped with the essential connectivity to have a successful meeting. USB-C and HDMI local inputs provide simple methods for sharing content to a display. In addition to the wired inputs, the SW-220-TX-W also supports native wireless casting via Airplay and Miracast so content can be shared easily from a tablet or smartphone. Connect a 4K camera or other highspeed USB device to the USB 3.0 device ports and take advantage of the power and unification that is USB-C.

Designed to maximize collaboration in small meeting room & huddle spaces, professors and students alike can optimize learning space with a universally compatible presentation switcher without the need to fumble with cables. A compact & cost efficient solution for the simple BYOD meetings.

For the smaller sized meeting rooms, this presentation switcher brings those important corporate meetings together, conveniently allowing every participant to present at any time, and from anywhere in the room.
